classification.difficultyReason: Select the appropriate right-triangle ratio, substitute a taught special-angle value, and rearrange and simplify the exact side length.

content.prompt: Find $x$ in each of the following figures:

spec.description: Vertical right side, horizontal base, rising hypotenuse; decorative cyan fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at bottom right; opposite side to 60 degrees is 30; hypotenuse is x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Horizontal base and vertical right side; decorative orange fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 8; base x adjacent to 30 degrees; right angle at bottom right.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Vertical left side and horizontal base; decorative cyan fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Base 12 adjacent to 60 degrees; vertical side x opposite; right angle at bottom left.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Vertical left side and descending hypotenuse; decorative orange fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Base 9 adjacent to 30 degrees; hypotenuse x; right angle at bottom left.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Isosceles right triangle rising to the right; decorative orange fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse square root of 8; vertical side x opposite 45 degrees; right angle at bottom right.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Horizontal top side and vertical left side; decorative cyan fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at top left; 60 degrees at bottom left; opposite top side 30; hypotenuse x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Isosceles right triangle with vertical left side; decorative orange fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertical side 12 opposite 45 degrees; hypotenuse x; right angle at bottom left.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Horizontal base and vertical right side; decorative cyan fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 18; base x adjacent to 30 degrees; right angle at bottom right.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.
